topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stepped into the library, the morning light casting long shadows that seemed to align with my purpose. There, on the bulletin board, was a framed copy of my college application essay, nestled among other pieces of academic excellence. The words, those carefully chosen phrases that once kept me up into the early hours, now seemed to shimmer with a life of their own. Each sentence, a testament to the hours of contemplation and revision, stood there, undeniably mine. I stood a bit taller, my eyes tracing the familiar lines, noting the way the paper seemed to glow under the dim light. It was a moment I hadn’t anticipated, yet it felt like a fitting recognition of the effort poured into every word.
